blurb: Guests interact with at least 9 clean, healthy, and friendly animals including bunnies, chickens, ducks, guinea pigs, hamsters, hedgehogs, colorful hair sheep, and silky fainting goats. The farm offers traveling petting zoo services for events and limited on-farm appointments by reservation. The petting zoo area is handicap accessible with grassy and gravel terrain, no public restrooms, and limited parking.
